title: 第11章 七句话三个鞠躬拿下一个男人第12章 感血如喝水
content_zh:
正如李青山所想。
王教习见他摇头，便微微仰头，自傲道：
“因为我对自己够狠！
肉身境，又叫脱胎换骨境。
每一步蜕变都无比痛苦。
对自己不够狠的人，就算天资卓越、家财万贯，也会被卡住。”
说完，他还特意看了眼李青山。
见李青山面无表情，王教习心中索然无味。
这孩子，咋捧人都不会呢。
真是一点眼力劲都没有。
他只好咳嗽一声，继续道：
“算了算了。
这些以后你就清楚了。
继续说肉身境。
肉身境，分皮肉、筋骨、换血三个阶段。
这三个阶段，不分先后，但牵一发而动全身。
有天赋的，就先破筋骨关，后洗髓换血，最后再洗炼全身皮肉。
这样又快又安全。
没天赋，但有钱的，会利用大药，强行洗髓换血，进而促进筋骨和皮肉同时蜕变，直接一步到位。
就是一头猪，只要能忍受这个过程的极端痛苦，都能躺着完成。

最后就是没钱又没天赋的。
没钱又没天赋，就只能老老实实磨。
先磨皮肉，等皮肉通畅了，就要立刻停下皮肉的打磨，去磨筋骨，不然过强的皮肉，会直接崩断身体的筋骨，等筋骨健壮了，再继续磨皮肉...
整个过程，又慢又痛苦。
把握不好度，还极容易伤了自己。
但这也是大部分肉身境武人唯一能选的路。”
...
李青山听完王教习的教导，整个人豁然开朗，对于武道前期两境，也有了一个清晰的认知。
这钱花的太值了！
他连忙朝王教习恭敬行礼：“感谢教习细致入微的指点。”
王教习摆摆手：“不过是看你已经完成养身，只差锁住心猿，就多说了几句。”
他看了眼天色，正准备敷衍两句就下值。
李青山看出对方心思，开始发起了攻势：
“在下堂哥，早年就在武馆学习，耗尽全族底蕴，却连教习刚刚指点的境界之分都没弄明白，可见刚刚的指点，并不是教习需要教导的义务。
真传一句话，假传万卷书。
在教习看来，可能只是兴致来了，随口指点几句。
但于我而言，却是明确了武道前期的方向。
content_en:
Just as Li Qingshan thought.
When Wang Jiaoxi saw him shaking his head, he raised his head slightly and said proudly:
"Because I'm so cruel to myself!
The physical state is also called the state of rebirth.
Every step of transformation is extremely painful.
People who are not cruel to themselves will still be stuck, even if they are talented and wealthy. "
After saying that, he looked at Li Qingshan specifically.
Seeing Li Qingshan's expressionless face, Wang Jiaoxi felt bored.
This kid doesn't even know how to compliment others.
There is really no discernment at all.
He had no choice but to cough and continue:
“Forget it, forget it.
You will understand this later.
Let’s continue talking about the physical state.
The physical realm is divided into three stages: skin and flesh, muscles and bones, and blood exchange.
These three stages are not in any particular order, but they affect the whole body.
Those who are talented will first break the muscles and bones, then cleanse the marrow and exchange blood, and finally clean the skin and flesh of the whole body.
It's fast and safe.
Those who have no talent, but have money, will use big medicine to forcefully cleanse the marrow and exchange blood, thereby promoting the simultaneous transformation of muscles, bones, skin and flesh, directly achieving the goal in one step.
Even a pig can do it lying down as long as he can endure the extreme pain of the process.
In the end, there are those who have no money and no talent.
If you have no money and no talent, you can only work hard.
Grind the skin and flesh first. Once the skin and flesh are smooth, you must immediately stop polishing the skin and flesh to grind the muscles and bones. Otherwise, the skin and flesh that is too strong will directly break the muscles and bones of the body. When the muscles and bones are strong, you can continue grinding the skin and flesh...
The whole process was slow and painful.
If you don't grasp the degree well, it's very easy to hurt yourself.
But this is also the only path that most warriors in the physical realm can choose. "
...
After listening to Wang Jiaoxi's teachings, Li Qingshan suddenly became enlightened and had a clear understanding of the two early stages of martial arts.
It’s money well spent!
He quickly saluted Professor Wang respectfully: "Thank you Professor Wang for your meticulous guidance."
Wang Jiaoxi waved his hand: "I just saw that you have completed your health training and just need to lock the heart, so I said a few more words."
He glanced at the sky and was about to give in with a few perfunctory words.
Li Qingshan saw the opponent's thoughts and launched an offensive:
"My cousin studied in a martial arts school in his early years and exhausted all his family's knowledge, but he didn't even understand the difference between the realms that the teacher just taught. It can be seen that the guidance just now is not the teacher's obligation to teach.
One sentence of truth is preached, and tens of thousands of books are falsely preached.
From the teacher's point of view, it may be that he just got interested and gave some casual advice.
But for me, it clarified the direction of martial arts in the early stage.
